title: CSA Subscription Request Form
subtitle: Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: CSA Subscription Request Form covers subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication. The CSA program coordinator records Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription need, timing, access, and assignment. CSA Subscription Request Form keeps Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription exceptions visible until the CSA program coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use CSA Subscription Request Form at farm program, packing point, pickup site, delivery route, and subscriber handoff. Document subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication identity before Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription begins. Compare subscriber, share plan, season, pickup site, distribution, substitution, credit, and communication findings with stated Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription criteria; route unresolved Community-Supported Agriculture Subscription issues to farm subscription operations reviewer.

Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to CSA program coordinator.
